title: PANAR-X reproducibility package: Stability-Constrained Regime-Aware Forecasting for Heterogeneous Panel Time Series (NeurIPS 2026)
description: Code, pre-registered design documents, archived run artifacts, and verification scripts for the NeurIPS 2026 paper "Stability-Constrained Regime-Aware Forecasting for Heterogeneous Panel Time Series" (submission 18877). Two scripts check every number in the paper against the archived artifacts without retraining: verify_paper_numbers.py (submitted-version numbers) and verify_camera_ready_numbers.py (camera-ready additions). Code is MIT licensed; the V-Dem v15 panel included under data/ is CC BY 4.0 (Varieties of Democracy Project). The realized-volatility input panel is not redistributed; see the README.
